event_name: Super Grip NHRA Thunder Valley Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 78 degrees, relative humidity 74 percent, barometer 29.90 inches, adjusted
altitude 3,787 feet, track temperature 106 degrees.

Gordon is 2 - 0 against Stewart in prior events. 

Stewart with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  Stewart is dropping cylinders right
in the light, but gets the win.

Gordon is straight down the groove with a good pass in the losing effort.

This is the 98th meeting between Schumacher & Kalitta and that's most for any two TF drivers (and 4th most
between any 2 Pro drivers)

Schumacher is 55 - 42 against Kalitta in prior events. 

Kalitta with a tick advantage and never trailed for the win.  Kalitta with his quickest pass of the weekend
for the win.

Schumacher had a hole out early and stayed with it.  On the top end the engine let go and the word is there is
oil.  Tony Schumacher was charged with an oildown, #4 for the season.
That will cost 15 points.

Brown is 6 - 1 against Reed in prior events. 

Brown with the starting line and never trailed for the win.  He makes his quickest pass of the weekend.  He
will give up lane choice to Kalitta in the semifinal.

Leah Pruett is 65 - 66 in Rd. 2

Langdon is 18 - 9 against Pruett in prior events. 

Langdon with problems with the throttle cable after the burnout.  He is first off the line and he is straight
down the groove. He is dropping cylinders from half track on.  He still gets the win.  Langdon will give up
lane choice to Stewart in the semifinal.

Pruett is up in smoke right at the hit and pedaled it, but couldn't get it to hook up.
